eventbrite.name: Eventbrite
eventbrite.fee_note: Eventbrite fees: 6.95% + £0.59 per ticket (includes payment processing). Chobble Tickets: £50/year or £5/month flat + Stripe processing (1.5% + 20p).

bookitbee.name: BookitBee
bookitbee.fee_note: BookitBee fees: from 3.5% per ticket (up to 6.5% for advanced features), min £0.50, max £19.95 cap, plus Stripe processing (1.5% + 20p). Chobble Tickets: £50/year or £5/month flat + Stripe processing (1.5% + 20p). Source: bookitbee.com/pricing (August 2026).

ticketmaster.name: Ticketmaster
ticketmaster.fee_note: Ticketmaster fees vary by event and venue. This estimate uses approximately 10% + £2.50 per ticket (bundled). Actual fees may be higher or lower. Chobble Tickets: £50/year or £5/month flat + Stripe processing (1.5% + 20p).

hi_events.name: Hi.Events
hi_events.fee_note: Hi.Events cloud fees: 0.75% + ~32p per ticket, plus Stripe processing (1.5% + 20p). Self-hosted Hi.Events has no platform fees, only Stripe processing. Chobble Tickets: £50/year or £5/month flat + Stripe processing (1.5% + 20p).

hi_events_selfhosted.name: Hi.Events Self-Hosted
hi_events_selfhosted.fee_note: Hi.Events Single Domain commercial license: $499 (approx. £420). AGPL edition is free but requires 'Powered by Hi.Events' branding. Multi-tenant licenses are available at higher tiers; contact Hi.Events for pricing. Chobble Tickets self-hosting has no Chobble software licence fee; infrastructure and payment processing remain separate. Source: hi.events/pricing and hi.events/open-source-event-ticketing (March 2026).

pretix_hosted.name: Pretix Hosted
pretix_hosted.fee_note: Pretix Hosted fees: 2.5% of ticket price excl. taxes (capped at €15/ticket, approx. £13). Payment provider fees (e.g. Stripe 1.5% + 20p, PayPal, or Mollie) are charged separately on top. Chobble Tickets: £50/year or £5/month flat + Stripe processing (1.5% + 20p).

pretix_selfhosted.name: Pretix Enterprise
pretix_selfhosted.fee_note: Pretix Enterprise Starter license: €499/year (approx. £420). Community edition is free but lacks proprietary plugins. Chobble Tickets self-hosting has no Chobble software licence fee; infrastructure and payment processing remain separate.

fatsoma.name: Fatsoma
fatsoma.fee_note: Fatsoma fees: 10% per ticket (minimum £1), plus Stripe processing (1.5% + 20p). Chobble Tickets: £50/year or £5/month flat + Stripe processing (1.5% + 20p). Source: ticketing.fatsoma.com/pricing (March 2026).

resident_advisor.name: Resident Advisor
resident_advisor.fee_note: Resident Advisor says buyers pay a service fee on each ticket but does not publish a general rate schedule. This calculator uses an unverified third-party estimate of approximately 10% including payment processing, so actual charges may differ. Chobble Tickets: £50/year or £5/month flat + Stripe processing (1.5% + 20p). Source for RA fee structure: support.ra.co (checked 25 July 2026).

dice.name: DICE
dice.fee_note: DICE fees are negotiated per partnership and not publicly disclosed. This estimate uses approximately 10% per ticket (bundled, including payment processing). Actual fees may vary. Chobble Tickets: £50/year or £5/month flat + Stripe processing (1.5% + 20p).

dandelion.name: Dandelion
dandelion.fee_note: Dandelion has no annual subscription or mandatory fee on tickets sold through Dandelion. This calculation includes UK Stripe processing (1.5% + 20p) and assumes one ticket per payment transaction. It excludes Dandelion's normally requested 1% organiser contribution, optional buyer donations, promotion contributions, and event boosts. Chobble Tickets: £50/year or £5/month flat + Stripe processing (1.5% + 20p), using the same one-ticket-per-transaction assumption. Sources: dandelion.events/docs/events and current source code (22 July 2026).

pta_events.name: PTA Events
pta_events.fee_note: PTA Events Starter plan fees: 3.95% per transaction + Stripe processing (1.5% + 20p). Premium plan (£299.99+VAT/year) reduces platform fee to 1.5%. Fees can be passed to buyers. Chobble Tickets: £50/year or £5/month flat (£25/year for community groups on the annual plan) + Stripe processing (1.5% + 20p). Source: ptaevents.freshdesk.com (March 2026).

eventim_light.name: EVENTIM.Light
eventim_light.fee_note: EVENTIM.Light fees: 8% per ticket (includes payment processing). Fee can be passed to ticket buyers or absorbed by the organiser. No fixed costs or binding contracts. Chobble Tickets: £50/year or £5/month flat + Stripe processing (1.5% + 20p). Source: eventim-light.co.uk/pricing (March 2026).

ticketek.name: Ticketek
ticketek.fee_note: Ticketek fees vary by event and venue. This estimate uses approximately AU$8 per transaction (converted to GBP) as a typical service and handling fee. Actual fees may be higher or lower. Chobble Tickets: £50/year or £5/month flat + Stripe processing (1.5% + 20p).

tito.name: Tito
tito.fee_note: Tito fees: 3% per ticket (2.5% for charity/non-profit/community), capped at €25 per ticket. Payment processing (e.g. Stripe 1.5% + 20p) is separate. Free events have no fees. Chobble Tickets: £50/year or £5/month flat + Stripe processing (1.5% + 20p). Source: ti.to/pricing (March 2026).

ticket_tailor.name: Ticket Tailor
ticket_tailor.fee_note: Ticket Tailor pay-as-you-go fee: £0.60 per paid ticket (flat, no percentage). Prepaid credits reduce this to as little as £0.22 per ticket in bulk (500 credits = £0.41 each; minimum purchase 100 credits). Registered charities get 50% off; PTAs and B Corps get 20% off. Free events are free up to 5,000 tickets per year. Payment processing via Stripe (1.5% + 20p), PayPal, or Square is charged separately. Custom domain is £7/month extra, or free when bundled with white-label. Chobble Tickets: £50/year or £5/month flat + Stripe processing (1.5% + 20p). Source: tickettailor.com/pricing (April 2026).

cheddar_up.name: Cheddar Up
cheddar_up.fee_note: Cheddar Up Team plan: $420/year (approx. £335) required for ticketing with QR codes. Convenience fees: 3.59% + $0.59 (approx. 47p) per transaction (includes payment processing via Stripe). Fees can be passed to payers or absorbed by the organiser. Chobble Tickets: £50/year or £5/month flat + Stripe processing (1.5% + 20p). Source: cheddarup.com/pricing (March 2026).

signupgenius.name: SignUpGenius (+ ads)
signupgenius.fee_note: SignUpGenius Tickets fees: $0.25 (approx. 20p) per ticket, plus Stripe processing (1.5% + 20p). Payment collection on standard sign-ups is charged separately at 5% + $0.50 per transaction. Chobble Tickets: £50/year or £5/month flat + Stripe processing (1.5% + 20p). Source: signupgenius.com/pricing (March 2026).

sumup_store.name: SumUp Online Store
sumup_store.fee_note: SumUp Online Store: no subscription, but each online payment costs 2.5% (includes payment processing; 0% when the buyer pays in person with a SumUp personal card). Chobble Tickets: £50/year or £5/month flat + Stripe processing (1.5% + 20p). If you connect a SumUp account to Chobble Tickets instead, the same 2.5% online processing applies to both. Source: sumup.com/en-gb/pricing (checked 1 August 2026).

wix_events.name: Wix Events
wix_events.fee_note: Wix Events fees: 2.5% ticket service fee per paid ticket, plus Wix Payments processing (2.1% + 20p in the UK). Requires a Wix Business & eCommerce plan (from $29/month, approx. £23/month or £276/year). Free tickets have no service fee. Chobble Tickets: £50/year or £5/month flat + Stripe processing (1.5% + 20p). Source: support.wix.com (March 2026).

fixr.name: FIXR (Pro)
fixr.fee_note: FIXR Pro fees: 4.99% + £0.49 per ticket (£1 minimum) + VAT (includes payment processing). Student & Charity tier: 3.99% + £0.49. Fees are typically paid by the ticket buyer but can be absorbed by the organiser. Chobble Tickets: £50/year or £5/month flat + Stripe processing (1.5% + 20p). Source: fixr.co/pricing (March 2026).

fooevents.name: FooEvents (Basic Bundle)
fooevents.fee_note: FooEvents Basic Bundle: $139/year (approx. £103) for a Single Domain plugin licence, which includes 12 months of support and updates. Bookings Bundle: $169 (approx. £125). Premium Bundle: $199 (approx. £147). Point of Sale Bundle: $349 (approx. £258). Licences for multiple or unlimited domains cost more. No per-ticket fees. Payment processing is handled by your own WooCommerce payment gateway (e.g. Stripe 1.5% + 20p in the UK). Running FooEvents also requires a WordPress + WooCommerce site, which has its own hosting costs (typically £5-£25/month). Chobble Tickets: £50/year or £5/month flat + Stripe processing (1.5% + 20p). Source: fooevents.com/pricing (April 2026).

resova.name: Resova (Pro)
resova.fee_note: Resova Pro plan: $72/month billed annually (approx. £685/year), covering up to 300 bookings per month. Lite ($40/month = approx. £380/year, up to 100 bookings/month) and Premium ($108/month = approx. £1025/year, up to 600 bookings/month) tiers also available, plus custom Enterprise pricing. Overage: $0.20 per booking (approx. 16p) above the monthly limit. Payment processing via Stripe, PayPal, Square, or Resova's own SpeedPay is charged separately (Stripe 1.5% + 20p in the UK). Chobble Tickets: £50/year or £5/month flat + Stripe processing (1.5% + 20p). Source: get.resova.com/pricing (April 2026).

tessera_tickets.name: Tessera Tickets
tessera_tickets.fee_note: Tessera Tickets subscription: from $125/month (approx. £1,200/year) for up to 10,000 tickets per year, rising to $667/month (approx. £6,400/year) for up to 100,000 tickets per year. Volumes above that are quoted on request. WordPress hosting for the public-facing website is a separate $150-$400/month (approx. £1,440-£3,840/year). One-off setup fees range from free (do-it-yourself) to $3,500 for the Template Plus theme, $6,000+ for a custom design, or $10,000+ for a complete redesign. Seating chart setup costs $500-$1,000 extra, point-of-sale hardware around $300 per device, and barcode reader licensing from $100/month for up to five devices. Payment processing via Stripe (1.5% + 20p in the UK) or Authorize.net is charged separately. Chobble Tickets: £50/year or £5/month flat + Stripe processing (1.5% + 20p). Source: tessera-tickets.com/pricing (April 2026).

tickts_starter.name: tickts (Starter)
tickts_starter.fee_note: tickts Starter fees: free plan with 0% commission and no booking fees for fans, plus Stripe processing (1.5% + 20p). Advanced features (payment plans, waitlists, season passes, white-label, full API) require Growth (£290/year) or Pro (£690/year). Chobble Tickets: £50/year or £5/month flat (£25/year for charities on the annual plan), all features included + Stripe processing (1.5% + 20p). Source: tickts.co.uk/pricing (July 2026).

tickts_pro.name: tickts (Pro)
tickts_pro.fee_note: tickts Pro fees: £690/year (annual billing) or £69/month (monthly billing, £828/year). 0% commission and no booking fees for fans, plus Stripe processing (1.5% + 20p). Pro adds season passes, white-label subdomain, queue system, fan CRM, full API access, and removing tickts branding. Chobble Tickets: £50/year or £5/month flat (£25/year for charities on the annual plan), all features included + Stripe processing (1.5% + 20p). Source: tickts.co.uk/pricing (July 2026).

humanitix.name: Humanitix
humanitix.fee_note: Humanitix Standard fees: 4.67% + £0.46 per paid ticket (excl. VAT, includes payment processing via Humanitix Payments or Stripe). Charities and schools pay 3.33% + £0.25. Free events are free. There is no annual subscription fee. Chobble Tickets: £50/year or £5/month flat (£25/year for charities, community groups, artists and musicians on the annual plan) + Stripe processing (1.5% + 20p). Source: humanitix.com/gb/pricing (July 2026).

ticketpass_essentials.name: Ticketpass (Essentials)
ticketpass_essentials.fee_note: Ticketpass Essentials fees: a booking fee of 1.9% + £0.20 and a separate service fee of 1.9% + £0.20 on each paid ticket, so 3.8% + 40p in total (excl. VAT). Card processing is covered inside the booking fee. Free events are free, and up to 50% of the booking fee is donated to a chosen charity project. Chobble Tickets: £50/year or £5/month flat (£25/year for charities, community groups, artists and musicians on the annual plan) + Stripe processing (1.5% + 20p). Source: ticketpass.org/pricing (July 2026).

ticketpass_pro.name: Ticketpass (Pro)
ticketpass_pro.fee_note: Ticketpass Pro fees: a booking fee of 3.5% + £0.35 and a separate service fee of 3.5% + £0.35 on each paid ticket, so 7% + 70p in total (excl. VAT). Pro adds reserved seating, waiting lists, memberships and a website widget. Card processing is covered inside the booking fee, and up to 50% of the booking fee is donated to a chosen charity project. Chobble Tickets: £50/year or £5/month flat (£25/year for charities, community groups, artists and musicians on the annual plan) + Stripe processing (1.5% + 20p). Source: ticketpass.org/pricing (July 2026).

eventprime_professional.name: EventPrime (Professional)
eventprime_professional.fee_note: EventPrime Professional: $99 (approx. £73) for a single site, or $189 (approx. £140) for unlimited sites, paid once. The tier adds Event Tickets, Stripe Payments, Square Payments, live seating, coupons and invoices. The licence is paid once and includes 12 months of support and updates; this calculator assumes it is renewed each year, because a lapsed licence stops receiving updates including security fixes. No per-ticket fees. Payment processing is handled by your own gateway (e.g. Stripe 1.5% + 20p in the UK). Running EventPrime also requires a WordPress site, which has its own hosting costs (typically £5-£25/month). Chobble Tickets: £50/year or £5/month flat (£25/year for charities, community groups, artists and musicians on the annual plan) + Stripe processing (1.5% + 20p). Source: theeventprime.com/all-extensions (July 2026).

eventprime_business.name: EventPrime (Business)
eventprime_business.fee_note: EventPrime Business: listed at $179 (approx. £133) for a single site and $349 (approx. £258) for unlimited sites, advertised at $119 and $229 during a sale in July 2026. The tier adds the seat plan builder, attendee check-in, RSVP, waiting lists, advanced reports and offline payments. The licence is paid once and includes 12 months of support and updates; this calculator assumes it is renewed each year, because a lapsed licence stops receiving updates including security fixes. No per-ticket fees. Payment processing is handled by your own gateway (e.g. Stripe 1.5% + 20p in the UK). Running EventPrime also requires a WordPress site, which has its own hosting costs (typically £5-£25/month). Chobble Tickets: £50/year or £5/month flat (£25/year for charities, community groups, artists and musicians on the annual plan) + Stripe processing (1.5% + 20p). Source: theeventprime.com/all-extensions (July 2026).

weezevent.name: Weezevent
weezevent.fee_note: Weezevent fees: 2.5% + £0.99 including tax on each paid ticket sold online, with banking fees included and no setup fee or subscription. Free events cost nothing. Ticket income is paid out every 15 days. Chobble Tickets: £50/year or £5/month flat (£25/year for charities, community groups, artists and musicians on the annual plan) + Stripe processing (1.5% + 20p). Source: weezevent.com/en-gb/our-prices (July 2026).

ticketsource.name: TicketSource
ticketsource.fee_note: TicketSource booking fee with TicketSource payment processing: 7% per paid booking excluding VAT, minimum £0.25, with card processing included in the fee. The fee is charged per booking, so a multi-ticket booking is charged once and the real cost of one order can be lower than this per-ticket estimate. Registered charities pay 6.5%. Free events carry no fee up to 1,000 tickets. Chobble Tickets: £50/year or £5/month flat + Stripe processing (1.5% + 20p). Source: ticketsource.co.uk/pricing (July 2026).

ticketsource_stripe.name: TicketSource (own Stripe)
ticketsource_stripe.fee_note: TicketSource booking fee when you connect your own Stripe account: 4.5% per paid booking excluding VAT, minimum £0.25, plus Stripe processing (1.5% + 20p) charged to you directly. The fee is charged per booking, so a multi-ticket booking is charged once. Registered charities pay 4%. Chobble Tickets: £50/year or £5/month flat + Stripe processing (1.5% + 20p). Source: ticketsource.co.uk/pricing (July 2026).

tixfox.name: TixFox
tixfox.fee_note: TixFox fees: £0.38 per paid ticket, or £0.30 for tickets priced under £5, with the pricing page's currency selector set to pounds (US$0.39 and US$0.30 under US$5 in dollars). This calculator applies the standard £0.38 rate at every ticket price, so it does not model the reduced under-£5 rate. Free events carry no fee and there is no subscription. Ticket revenue goes directly to your own Stripe account via Stripe Connect, with Stripe processing charged separately (1.5% + 20p in the UK, as quoted on TixFox's own pricing page). TixFox platform fees are not refunded when a ticket is refunded. Chobble Tickets: £50/year or £5/month flat (£25/year for charities, community groups, artists and musicians on the annual plan) + Stripe processing (1.5% + 20p). Source: tixfox.co/pricing (August 2026).

qrticket.name: QRTicket
qrticket.fee_note: QRTicket charges €0.90 (incl. VAT, about £0.77) per ticket sold. By default the ticket buyer pays the fee, so the organiser pays nothing; the organiser can choose to absorb it instead. This calculator shows the absorbed case, with QRTicket's €0.90 plus PayPal processing (€0.39 + 3.0% per payment, about £0.33 + 3%, as of April 2022). Bank transfers carry no processing fee. Benefit (Benefiz) events with free tickets, cancelled tickets and vouchers carry no QRTicket fee. Ticket money goes directly to the organiser's own bank or PayPal account. Chobble Tickets: £50/year or £5/month flat (£25/year for charities, community groups, artists and musicians on the annual plan) + Stripe/Square/SumUp processing (1.5% + 20p). Source: qrticket.de (August 2026).

ticket_generator.name: Ticket Generator
ticket_generator.fee_note: Ticket Generator credit packs: 10 credits for $6, 100 for $50, 1,000 for $400 and 10,000 for $2,500 (one credit generates one ticket; events with a venue layout use two credits per ticket). The first 10 credits are free and credits do not expire. This estimate uses the smallest pack rate of $0.60 per ticket (about £0.47); bulk packs reduce the per-ticket cost to as little as $0.25 (about £0.20) at 10,000 credits. Credits apply to free and paid tickets alike. Payment processing for collected payments is not published separately, so UK Stripe processing (1.5% + 20p) is shown as a typical assumption. Chobble Tickets: £50/year or £5/month flat (£25/year for charities, community groups, artists and musicians on the annual plan) + Stripe processing (1.5% + 20p), with no charge for issuing tickets on free events. Source: ticket-generator.com/pricing (July 2026).

smartgig.name: SmartGig
smartgig.fee_note: SmartGig prices its Ticketing module at £80/month or £800/year on annual billing. Its published prices list no fee per ticket sold, so this estimate assumes none; no reviewed source states outright that no per-sale fee applies. This estimate uses the annual rate for ticketing alone. Other parts of the platform are priced separately, including White Label custom domains at £50/month, Trader Manager, Transport Manager and Stage Manager at £20/month each, and Site Plan, team access and recurring events at £10/month each, so a real package can cost more. Ticket revenue goes directly to your own Stripe account via Stripe Connect, with Stripe processing charged separately (1.5% + 20p in the UK). Chobble Tickets: £50/year or £5/month flat (£25/year for charities, community groups, artists and musicians on the annual plan) + Stripe processing (1.5% + 20p). Source: smartgig.co.uk package builder (August 2026).

eventschedule.name: Event Schedule (Pro)
eventschedule.fee_note: Event Schedule charges no platform fee on ticket sales. Its paid plans are a flat subscription in US dollars: Pro at US$5/month or US$50/year (about £40/year) unlocks unlimited ticket sales and removes Event Schedule branding, and Enterprise at US$15/month or US$150/year (about £120/year) adds custom domains and extra team members. A free plan sells up to 25 paid tickets a month and carries Event Schedule branding. This calculator uses the Pro annual rate, converted to about £40, with UK Stripe processing (1.5% + 20p) to match the Chobble figures; Event Schedule's own pages quote US Stripe at 2.9% + US$0.30. Ticket income goes to the organiser's own Stripe account, and the software is open source, so self-hosting carries no Event Schedule fee. Chobble Tickets: £50/year or £5/month flat (£25/year for charities, community groups, artists and musicians on the annual plan) + Stripe/Square/SumUp processing (1.5% + 20p). Source: eventschedule.com/pricing (August 2026).

ticketebo.name: Ticketebo
ticketebo.fee_note: Ticketebo fees: 4.95% (incl. VAT) of the total transaction value per order, with a minimum of 75p (incl. VAT) per transaction, and card processing included. No subscription, no setup fee and no per-ticket charge. The fee is charged per order, so a multi-ticket booking is charged once. By default the buyer pays the fee on top of the ticket price, but the organiser can absorb it. With a connected Stripe account, a rebate of up to 20% of the booking fee is paid to the organiser after the event, and Stripe processing (1.5% + 20p in the UK) applies separately. Registered charities receive a 10% donation of booking fees back. This calculator applies 4.95% per ticket and does not model the 75p per-transaction minimum, which raises the effective rate on low-value orders. Chobble Tickets: £50/year or £5/month flat (£25/year for charities, community groups, artists and musicians on the annual plan) + Stripe processing (1.5% + 20p). Source: ticketebo.co.uk/pricing (August 2026).

revel.name: Revel
revel.fee_note: Revel's hosted service charges 3% + €0.50 (about 43p) on each paid ticket it processes, and nothing for free events or events where the organiser handles payment. Revel prices in euros; the figures here convert €0.50 to about 43p so they sit beside the pound amounts on this site. Revel takes payment through Stripe, so Stripe processing (1.5% + 20p in the UK) applies separately from Revel's commission. Revel's code is open source under the MIT licence, so self-hosting carries no Revel fee. Chobble Tickets: £50/year or £5/month flat (£25/year for charities, community groups, artists and musicians on the annual plan) + Stripe, Square or SumUp processing; this calculator uses Stripe's UK rate of 1.5% + 20p, and Square and SumUp differ. Source: letsrevel.io (August 2026).

revel_selfhosted.name: Revel Self-Hosted
revel_selfhosted.fee_note: Revel is open source under the MIT licence, so self-hosting carries no Revel platform fee and no per-ticket commission. You pay only your own server costs and Stripe processing (1.5% + 20p in the UK). Revel needs a Django application server with PostgreSQL, Redis and background workers, so plan for a small always-on server. Chobble Tickets self-hosting also has no Chobble software licence fee; it compiles to a single JavaScript file and runs on serverless edge infrastructure. Source: github.com/letsrevel (August 2026).
